_doc: CR264 - controls that spend real credits / LLM runs. At most `limit` presses per crawl in each group; the rest are recorded as exempt ('covered by intent, not pressed: <group> budget'). A group only counts a press when the catalogue says the control is destructive (or has no catalogue entry): opening the empty convene sheet is free and is always pressed.

room.why: opening the Room auto-starts a 12-agent run and spends a Room credit

one_on_one.why: each 1-on-1 send is a real LLM turn

brief.why: each Brief chat send is a real LLM turn
